issues.quote: Duplicate title tag — `/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` both use `Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita`.
Flores Bajawa is linked from nowhere except the sitemap, so it's effectively an orphan.
`FAQPage` schema, but the questions and answers are **not visible on the page**
"2024" baked into an evergreen URL and title

wrong_findings.claim: “Every page except `/contact/` has a unique title under ~65 characters (apart from #6).”
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The title on `/coffee/bali-kintamani/` is 88 characters, as shown in crawl.csv; the audit itself also lists it as 88 characters in the crawl evidence it cites.
The crawl and sitemap show all existing indexable HTML pages are listed. The other crawl URLs are assets, redirects, or 404s.

extra_true.finding: `/coffee/flores-bajawa/` has no Product schema despite having a price and image.
The three blog Article schemas omit `image`, `publisher`, and an author URL.
The Article headline for `/blog/best-coffee-beans-2024/` does not match the page H1.
No Open Graph or Twitter metadata is present on the pages.

notes: Found 19 of 20 planted issues; the overly long Bali Kintamani title is not identified as a problem. The unrequested additions list is empty.
